description: A function-local import hides a transitive dependency from the module-level index.

expected_affected.tests/test_worker.py::test_read: worker.read imports and calls core.price inside its body, so its result depends on the changed function.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.

false_negatives.tests/test_worker.py::test_read: No module import or resolved call edge connects worker.read to core because the import is local.

limitations: Function-local imports are not indexed as bindings or module imports; the affected caller test is missed.
